timeline.summary: Shradha Suri, promoter, declared no encumbrance on Subros Limited’s equity shares by promoters or PAC during FY2025-26, filed April 1, 2026.
SHRADHA SURI declared no promoter or PAC share encumbrance in Subros Limited for FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,049.76 Cr (+15.6% YoY), net profit ₹49.33 Cr (+6.8% YoY).
Subros reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,050 Cr, up 15.55% YoY, and full-year FY26 PAT of ₹165.78 Cr.
Subros Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Investor Conference Call on May 19, 2026, discussing FY2025-26 audited results.
Subros reported Q1FY27 results with flat revenue at ₹1,032 Cr and PAT at ₹41.52 Cr
Subros inaugurated the Subros Advanced Technologies & Innovation Centre (SATIC) at Noida on October 15, 2026.
